spanish: Todas las columnas del atrio alrededor bandeadas plata, y sus ganchos plata, y sus basas bronce.

findings.issue: Unmarked y has no conjunction token. וָוֵיהֶם is the plural noun “hooks” plus a 3mp suffix; its morph has no HC, and the opening ו is the root, so the link after plata is asyndetic.

notes: The ו on וְאַדְנֵיהֶם licenses only the second y, before sus basas.
